2609.01431.title: Efficiently Estimating Optimal Hyperparameter Scaling Laws through Power-Law Entropy Search
2609.01431.paper_summary: Optimal hyperparameter scaling laws describe how the best hyperparameters for large language model (LLM) training change with model and data scale, enabling practitioners to predict optimal configurations at production scales without expensive large-scale tuning. However, estimating these scaling laws conventionally requires exhaustive grid searches over thousands of training runs, consuming enormous computational resources. We introduce Power-Law Entropy Search (PLES), a computational cost-aware acquisition function built on multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization that efficiently estimates optimal hyperparameter scaling laws through adaptive experimentation. A key innovation in PLES is that it searches for candidates that reduce the overall uncertainty of a scaling law estimate, instead of optimizing a single objective function. At each iteration, PLES selects the candidate configuration that maximally reduces the uncertainty of the scaling law estimates per unit computational cost, naturally favoring informative small-scale experiments. We evaluate PLES on synthetic benchmarks, surrogate models fitted to real LLM training data, and actual LLM pre-training runs. Across all settings, PLES converges to accurate optimal hyperparameter scaling laws using less than one-tenth of the computational budget required by conventional grid search and other baselines.
2609.01431.paper_summary_zh: 最佳超參數縮放法則描述了大型語言模型（LLM）訓練的最佳超參數如何隨著模型和數據規模的變化而變化，使從業者能夠在生產規模下預測最佳配置，而無需昂貴的大規模調整。<lb/>然而，傳統上估算這些縮放法則需要對數千次訓練運行進行徹底的網格搜索，消耗巨大的計算資源。<lb/>我們引入了功率法則熵搜索（PLES），這是一種基於多保真度貝葉斯優化的計算成本感知獲取函數，通過自適應實驗有效估算最佳超參數縮放法則。<lb/>PLES的一個關鍵創新在於，它尋找能夠減少縮放法則估算總不確定性的候選者，而不是優化單一目標函數。<lb/>在每次迭代中，PLES選擇每單位計算成本最大程度減少縮放法則估算不確定性的候選配置，自然偏向於信息豐富的小規模實驗。<lb/>我們在合成基準、擬合真實LLM訓練數據的代理模型以及實際LLM預訓練運行中評估PLES。<lb/>在所有設置中，PLES使用的計算預算不到傳統網格搜索和其他基準所需的十分之一，即收斂到準確的最佳超參數縮放法則。
